Subject: New vendor: Redwood Inference — vendor registration and PO requirements

Hi Hannah / Jordan,

We're ready to add Redwood Inference as an approved vendor in Nordica's AP system. To complete vendor setup our onboarding team needs a few items so payments and PO matching work cleanly on our side. Can you send the following?

- Completed vendor account form (attached template)
- Company tax evidence (W-9 for US entities or VAT registration for EU entities)
- Bank routing / wire instructions (CSV or PDF with ACH details)
- Invoice routing: which email should we send POs and remittances to?
- Any preferred invoice number format and whether you require the PO number to be present on each invoice for automated matching

Two quick notes about our workflow: Nordica requires PO numbers for invoices > $2,000 for automated matching, and for non-PO invoices we need an exception approved. If you expect to receive POs from multiple Nordica business units please indicate whether you want a single vendor record or separate ones by BU.

I've attached our vendor account template (vendor_account_form.xlsx). Let me know if you have a point of contact on Redwood's finance side who can provide the signed W-9 and bank details.

Thanks,
Oliver Grant
